metadata.selection_rule: highest positive mean daily RankIC after 0.70 absolute rank-correlation deduplication

aaa7b2e1bc196957.factor_description: Twenty-day net close return divided by the sum of absolute daily returns. Higher values represent a more persistent upward path.

metadata.hypothesis: A persistent upward price path with less path noise predicts a higher next-period return than a choppy path with the same net move.

feedback.reason: Pre-registered hypothesis; no historical strategy result was used to mark it accepted.

consistency_check.hypothesis_to_description: Both define persistence as net return relative to total path movement.
consistency_check.description_to_formulation: The numerator is the 20-day return and the denominator is absolute daily-return path length.
consistency_check.formulation_to_expression: TS_PCTCHANGE and TS_SUM(ABS(...)) implement the declared ratio without future references.
consistency_check.overall_feedback: Semantics and positive direction are aligned; this is not performance acceptance.

82c0e7bda4f4534f.factor_description: Twenty-day volume on up-close days minus volume on down-close days, normalized by total volume.
82c0e7bda4f4534f.factor_formulation: (sum V_i I(r_i>0) - sum V_i I(r_i<0)) / (sum V_i + epsilon)

metadata.hypothesis: Buying participation that dominates selling participation over twenty days predicts a higher next-period return.

feedback.reason: Pre-registered hypothesis; no historical strategy result was used to mark it accepted.

consistency_check.hypothesis_to_description: Up-day and down-day volume are used as observable participation proxies.
consistency_check.description_to_formulation: Signed conditional volume is normalized by total rolling volume.
consistency_check.formulation_to_expression: SUMIF conditions use contemporaneous and past close returns only, with no future reference.
consistency_check.overall_feedback: Semantics and positive direction are aligned; this is not performance acceptance.

5234175cf1b85da7.factor_description: Twenty-day volume-weighted location of VWAP inside each daily high-low range; higher values indicate accumulation near the upper range.
5234175cf1b85da7.factor_formulation: sum V_i (2 VWAP_i - H_i - L_i)/(H_i-L_i+epsilon) / (sum V_i+epsilon)

metadata.hypothesis: Sustained volume transacted nearer the upper part of the daily range indicates accumulation and predicts a higher next-period return.

feedback.reason: Pre-registered hypothesis; no historical strategy result was used to mark it accepted.

consistency_check.hypothesis_to_description: VWAP position within the range is the declared accumulation proxy.
consistency_check.description_to_formulation: The centered range location is weighted by volume and averaged over twenty days.
consistency_check.formulation_to_expression: The expression directly implements the declared range-location and rolling-volume normalization.
consistency_check.overall_feedback: Semantics and positive direction are aligned; this is not performance acceptance.

b2de955aa7c6bf26.factor_description: Current close location inside the prior twenty-day high-low range, centered at zero; higher values represent upside breakout pressure.
b2de955aa7c6bf26.factor_formulation: (C_t - min L_{t-20:t-1}) / (max H_{t-20:t-1} - min L_{t-20:t-1} + epsilon) - 0.5

metadata.hypothesis: A close near or above the top of the prior twenty-day range predicts a higher next-period return through momentum and breakout continuation.

feedback.reason: Pre-registered hypothesis; no historical strategy result was used to mark it accepted.

consistency_check.hypothesis_to_description: Both use current close location versus the prior range as breakout pressure.
consistency_check.description_to_formulation: The formula centers normalized prior-range location at zero.
consistency_check.formulation_to_expression: DELAY by one day ensures rolling highs and lows exclude the current day and all future data.
consistency_check.overall_feedback: Semantics and positive direction are aligned; this is not performance acceptance.
